jobs.title: Full-stack Developer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description:
W naszym projekcie nie piszesz kodu od zera. Jesteś osobą - pilotem, która nadzoruje agentów AI generujących architekturę 3-warstwową na podstawie User Stories. Twoim głównym zadaniem jest Code Review kodu generowanego przez AI, dbanie o czystość architektury (Clean Code) oraz rozwiązywanie problemów, które wykraczają poza możliwości obecnych modeli LLM.

Profil stanowiska

Doświadczenie w budowaniu skalowalnych aplikacji Full-stack (stos: .NET 8, C#, EF oraz Angular 21/TypeScript)
Zmysł architektoniczny – umiejętność korygowania błędów AI w strukturze 3-warstwowej
Umiejętność pracy z narzędziami typu Agentic AI (np. Claude Code) i zrozumienie Agentic Workflow
Solidna wiedza o bazach danych (MS SQL Server) – sprawne mapowanie danych przy przejściu z legacy

Twoje zadania

Nadzór nad generacją kodu poprzez instruowanie agentów AI w celu uzyskania optymalnej implementacji
Zaawansowane Code Review pod kątem bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i skalowalności kodu z AI
Integracja systemowa: Łączenie nowej warstwy webowej z logiką biznesową legacy poprzez stabilne API
Debugowanie "edge cases": Rozwiązywanie skomplikowanych błędów, z którymi AI sobie nie radzi

Dla Ciebie

Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych
System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy
Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura)
Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace
Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT
Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain robust, scalable
backend services and APIs powering Client facing Portal applications. The ideal
candidate has strong object-oriented development skills, experience with
containerized/cloud-native deployment, and the ability to collaborate closely with front-
end teams to deliver well-integrated, performant solutions.

What will your tasks involve?

Develop and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Java or .NET.
Design data models and integrate with relational/NoSQL databases as required by portal functionality.
Collaborate with front-end developers to define API contracts and ensure smooth integration.
Build and deploy services within containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift).
Implement secure coding practices, unit/integration testing, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
Optimize service performance, scalability, and reliability.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on-call/support rotations as needed.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.

What we expect from you?

Strong Java or .NET development experience (Spring Boot / .NET Core preferred).
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Experience with containerized applications and orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift).
Working SQL/database experience (relational data modeling, query optimization).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices.
Nice-to-Have: experience with messaging/event-driven architectures (Kafka, MQ, etc.), financial services, fund administration, or transfer agency domain experience, exposure to cloud-native development practices.

What you can expect from us?

Contract Stability
High level of autonomy and independence
Senior role: The chance to act as a Backend Developer
Participation in key projects
International collaboration: Building and cultivating partnerships across various business regions

jobs.title: Senior Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
📍 hybrid work - 3 days/week from the office

Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
Experience building and running containerized applications
Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Microservices architecture and system design
Messaging and integration technologies: Kafka, IBM MQ, Tibco EMS
Relational databases: Azure SQL, Oracle, Sybase
Testing frameworks (unit, integration and E2E testing)
CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / GitHub)
Monitoring and observability practices

Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Corporate Technology Solution Engineer/ Business Translator
plays a critical role in enabling Mars’ sustainability ambition by bridging corporate strategy, regulatory requirements, and digital technology delivery
.

This role partners closely with Sustainability, Risk, Legal, and Corporate teams to translate regulatory, reporting, and performance needs into practical, scalable digital solutions
that support environmental impact measurement, transparency, and decision‑making.

The role operates with defined scope and moderate autonomy
, owning delivery alignment for specific domains, initiatives, or platforms while contributing to broader corporate technology roadmaps under senior guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Act as a primary digital technology partner to Sustainability and related corporate functions (e.g., Risk, Legal, Sustainability).
Develop a strong understanding of Mars sustainability priorities, including climate, packaging, nature, and human rights topics.
Support business teams in translating sustainability goals and regulatory obligations into clear digital enablement needs.
Work with key business stakeholders to create proof of concept solutions leveraging basic coding and Power BI
Translate sustainability‑driven needs (e.g., GHG reporting, regulatory disclosures, supplier data, impact metrics) into structured problem statements, functional requirements, and success measures.
Help shift stakeholders from “tool requests” toward outcome‑based sustainability solutions.
Support prioritization by assessing regulatory urgency, business impact, feasibility, and delivery complexity.
Ensure requirements are clearly understood by delivery teams and aligned to enterprise standards.
Contribute to solution design for sustainability platforms and tools (e.g., emissions calculation, data ingestion, reporting, analytics).
Collaborate with architects, data engineers, and vendors to shape fit‑for‑purpose, scalable solutions.
Ensure sustainability solutions address data quality, auditability, security, traceability, and compliance needs.
Translate high‑level designs into delivery‑ready artifacts (epics, features, acceptance criteria).

Job Specifications/Qualifications

Education & Professional Qualification:

Minimum: Bachelor’s degree
Desired: PMI / PRINCE certifications; PMP / PgMP / PfMP / PRINCE2

Knowledge/Experience

5 years + of solution engineer experience focusing on cross-platform Data and Analytics solutions
Understanding of digital platforms, data pipelines, and analytics in an enterprise environment.
Ability to engage meaningfully in solution design discussions (technical fluency rather than coding).
Analytical mindset with attention to data quality, controls, and traceability.
Experience in system integration lifecycle including system design and deployment, systems integration, data migration, and data model design.
A track record of having led multiple medium and complex digital analytics platforms
Ability to remain flexible and resilient under pressure and comfortable in dealing with ambiguity in a fast-moving portfolio of activity.
Programming/scripting experience is a plus.
Familiarity with automation and low-code/no-code platforms awareness, such as – SNOW, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, Power Apps etc.
Familiarity with sustainability management platforms/tools ( Environmental impact assessment, carbon accounting, regulatory compliance etc.)
Awareness of sustainability regulatory compliance
